arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Paul Clement argued Section 271(f) prohibits specific domestic infringement acts.
Sri Shanmugam argued the presumption against extraterritoriality applies to remedial provisions.
Justice Breyer questioned whether foreign nations could adopt similar statutes.
Justice Gorsuch focused on the distinction between high seas and inland waters.
